PC WORKBASE

Public demo

PC WORKBASE is a read-only Django business workspace demo for managing customers, jobs, invoices and team workflows. Built with Django and PostgreSQL, with responsive layouts, PDF/CSV exports, role-based views and CZ/EN localization.

Fictional data. No registration required. Changes are not saved.

Project Details

A practical business workflow

Explore customers, jobs, sample invoice records and team responsibilities in one workspace. Search, filters and quick previews help connect related records.

A separate, read-only demo

PC WORKBASE is derived from Zakázkovník and runs with fictional data in an isolated database. You can try forms without saving changes, and download sample job PDFs and CSV exports.

Designed for different screens and languages

The interface supports Czech and English, with responsive views for desktop and mobile. The demo presents the owner’s view and explains team roles; visitors cannot change accounts or permissions.

Customers. Jobs. Clarity.PYTHON / DJANGO

Zakázkovník

Private application · Case study

Zakázkovník is a Django-based application for managing customers, jobs and related business records. The project includes role-based access, database-backed forms, PDF exports, REST API functionality and PostgreSQL integration.

The production deployment contains private business data and is therefore not publicly accessible. PC WORKBASE is a separate public demo derived from this project, using fictional data and an isolated database.
